patthana17.9:1.1: kusalaṃ ācayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kusalo na ācayagāmi dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā cha.
patthana17.9:2.1: kusalaṃ apacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kusalo na apacayagāmī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana17.9:3.1: abyākataṃ nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na abyākato na nevācayagāmi nāpacayagāmi dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā pañca.
